reviewed_contracts: Persisted Running/active projects to Interrupted, Error to Failed, paused/queue_paused/pending/held-edit to Paused, validated idle to Ready; unknown stays Unavailable.
Loaded controller presentation always precedes saved observations, including loading/load failure and published fatal Error; no lease clears live uncertainty.
SessionInspectionLease performs bounded schema/UUID/checkpoint/read-only journal validation, no controller creation, provider/tool execution, credentials, writes, recovery or resume.
One in-flight session per view survives scope invalidation until completion; parsed history and writer lease dropped promptly. Unknown attempts cached, no repeated render-loop retry.
Project path/workspace identity/window binding/navigation/load generation/epoch and exact ChatRecord reject stale completion. Loaded ownership rejects adoption and removes observations.
Same-length/mtime snapshot replacement is rejected by Unix inode/device fence; journal opener and final read validate identity.
Main module/state/render/label integration is narrow. Actual row-click handler selects then refreshes and notifies, enabling current-row reselection freshness.
